resolutions.resolution: Updated ADR-0001 to mandate minimum warm instances (min-instances=1) and connection pooling limits.
Updated ADR-0002 to mandate Cloud SQL Regional High Availability (HA) across multiple zones with automated failover.
Updated ADR-0002 to standardize on single primary region with Regional HA, avoiding cross-region egress traps while meeting 99% availability.
Updated ADR-0001 to specify request-scoped CPU allocation with auto-scaling to match real-time demand.
Updated ADR-0003 to confine Pub/Sub to asynchronous background notification events and audit ingestion, keeping core CRUD strictly transactional.
Updated ADR-0001 to structure the system as cohesive subsystems (task_service and audit_service) sharing clean modular boundaries.
